next_step: Closed-lost: collect internal win/loss notes and send final recap to exec sponsor; archive opportunity.
notes: Deal status: closed-lost — customer elected to consume OpenAI direct API for initial rollout.
Primary reason cited on final call: 'path of least resistance' — simpler onboarding and internal familiarity with OpenAI SDKs.
Security team flagged KMS/HSM and VPC connectivity as blockers early in procurement; asked for HSM integration timeline we couldn't commit to within their calendar.
Budget: exec finance implemented a hiring freeze + tools budget cap for Q1; buyer said 'we can't expand vendor list this quarter'.
Sponsor: CTO James Miller was favorable but deprioritized after ML infra lead (Sara Gomez) left; no replacement champion to push internal procurement.
POC summary: Redwood POC matched latency & cost targets in our benchmark but customer preferred vendor with existing credits and simpler tokenization hooks.
Competitive notes: buyer tried Anthropic briefly but felt OpenAI brand + existing partnerships with other product teams made it lowest friction.
Legal: requested template SLA edits (data residency + liability caps) that would have required escalations; customer chose speed over negotiated terms.
Quote from CTO on 2025-01-10 call: 'We like Redwood's observability but need the fastest route to ship — OpenAI wins on simplicity right now.'
AE activity: multiple pricing iterations, two extended technical workshops with SE, targeted canary rollout plan proposed but not prioritized.
recent_activities: 2024-11-20: Security questionnaire submitted; follow-up call to clarify KMS options
2024-12-05: POC completed (30-day) — evaluation report shared (drive link)
2024-12-18: Pricing revision v3 shared; finance asked for 60% discount scenario

use_case_summary: Primary focus: conversational assistant for customer support + semantic search embeddings for R&D knowledge base. Throughput target: 50 rps peak for chat, embeddings batch 20k docs initial. Latency SLO: 150-300ms per token (interactive). Cost sensitive — looking to optimize unit cost at scale.
technical_requirements: Need SAML SSO, SOC2 compliance evidence, KMS/HSM integration or bring-your-own-key, audit logs retention 1 year, EU data residency for subset of PII. Preferred model family: openweights or managed hosted models; flexibility to route lower-priority traffic to cheaper variants.
objections_and_replies: Objection: 'OpenAI is simpler and our devs already have client libraries' — Reply: emphasized Redwood's unified runtime, deployment parity (hosted/dedicated/private), and cost controls; offered a migration plan and templated SDK integrations. Objection: 'we have credits and an enterprise PO with OpenAI' — Reply: proposed limited pilot on Redwood Dedicated to demonstrate economics, but budget/capacity constraints prevented pilot funding.
final_decision_reason: Selected OpenAI direct API primarily for lowest friction onboarding and existing internal familiarity; secondary reasons include available credits and preference for single-vendor stack for initial product launch.
postmortem_actions: 1) Capture detailed win/loss and share to GTM. 2) Update docs to better address KMS/HSM timelines. 3) Create playbook for budget-freeze scenarios and internal champion loss. 4) Check back in Q3 2025 for renewal opportunity.
